name: Kanojo wa Maid
source:
One day, the main character becomes the owner of a mansion according to the will of its deceased former owner. The old butler instructs him on how to train the mansion's three maids.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有一天，主角按照已故前主人的遗嘱成为了一座宅邸的主人。老管家教他如何训练府里的三个丫鬟。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
